_comment: Free-roaming Kraken (lairhisson_boss:kraken) in all deep ocean biomes — they previously only existed inside the Kraken Lair structure. Weight 2 (very rare; vanilla guardians spawn at weight 1, drowned at 5). count 1/1 — never spawn as a group. WATER_CREATURE mob category matches the entity's registered category (squid-level). With Deeper Oceans active, deep ocean biomes have ~99-block water columns so the Kraken has plenty of space to swim around.
